capabilities.name: inspect_anim_blueprint_graph
capabilities.label: Inspect Anim Blueprint Graph
capabilities.summary: Read graph, node, pin, and link topology from an AnimBlueprint.

capabilities.name: add_anim_graph_state
capabilities.label: Add Anim Graph State
capabilities.summary: Create an AnimBlueprint state-machine state and optionally assign a sequence player. The C++ body is build-validated; target-asset live validation is still required before claiming mutation success.

capabilities.name: add_anim_graph_state_machine
capabilities.label: Add Anim Graph State Machine
capabilities.summary: Create or reuse a named state-machine node and bound graph in an Animation Blueprint AnimGraph.

capabilities.name: add_anim_graph_transition_rule
capabilities.label: Add Anim Graph Transition Rule
capabilities.summary: Create an AnimBlueprint state-machine transition edge and support constant true/false rule defaults. Complex rule graph synthesis still requires a separate validated capability.

capabilities.name: delete_anim_graph_state
capabilities.label: Delete Anim Graph State
capabilities.summary: Delete an AnimBlueprint state-machine state through a reflected C++ editor wrapper with readback.

capabilities.name: delete_anim_graph_transition
capabilities.label: Delete Anim Graph Transition
capabilities.summary: Delete an AnimBlueprint state-machine transition through a reflected C++ editor wrapper with readback.

capabilities.name: rename_anim_graph_state
capabilities.label: Rename Anim Graph State
capabilities.summary: Rename an AnimBlueprint state-machine state through a reflected C++ editor wrapper with readback.

capabilities.name: set_anim_graph_transition_rule
capabilities.label: Set Anim Graph Transition Rule
capabilities.summary: Set an existing AnimBlueprint transition rule through a reflected C++ editor wrapper. Constant true/false rules are supported; complex expression graph synthesis remains separate.

capabilities.name: synthesize_anim_graph_transition_rule_expression
capabilities.label: Synthesize Anim Graph Transition Rule Expression
capabilities.summary: Create Blueprint transition-rule nodes for bounded prompt-derived boolean expressions and wire the final bool into bCanEnterTransition with readback.

capabilities.name: wire_anim_graph_output_pose
capabilities.label: Wire Anim Graph Output Pose
capabilities.summary: Wire an AnimBlueprint state machine pose output into the AnimGraph output pose. The C++ body is build-validated; target-asset live validation is still required before claiming mutation success.

capabilities.name: compile_and_save_anim_blueprint
capabilities.label: Compile And Save Anim Blueprint
capabilities.summary: Compile and save an AnimBlueprint through the AIStudioBridge C++ wrapper.

capabilities.name: inspect_animation_sequence
capabilities.label: Inspect Animation Sequence
capabilities.summary: Read skeleton, duration, sample rate, sampled keys, and root-motion facts.

capabilities.name: configure_blend_space
capabilities.label: Configure Blend Space
capabilities.summary: Configure BlendSpace axes, add skeleton-compatible animation samples, save, and return per-sample readback.

capabilities.name: inspect_character_in_pie
capabilities.label: Inspect Character In PIE
capabilities.summary: Read a live character's movement, AnimInstance, active montage, and requested reflected properties.

capabilities.name: validate_character_montages_in_pie
capabilities.label: Validate Character Montages In PIE
capabilities.summary: Validate in PIE that a character class has a runtime AnimInstance matching the expected AnimBlueprint and that required montages can be played.

capabilities.name: inject_key_in_pie
capabilities.label: Inject Key In PIE
capabilities.summary: Inject a simulated keyboard or gamepad key event through the active PIE player controller.

capabilities.name: describe_blueprint_node_action
capabilities.label: Describe Blueprint Node Action
capabilities.summary: Resolve an exact graph-context palette action on a transient graph and return its node ownership and typed pin signature without modifying the source Blueprint.

capabilities.name: search_blueprint_node_actions
capabilities.label: Search Blueprint Node Actions
capabilities.summary: Search context-filtered live Blueprint palette actions and return ranked exact action identifiers without modifying the source Blueprint.

capabilities.name: configure_blueprint_replication
capabilities.label: Configure Blueprint Replication
capabilities.summary: Set Blueprint member variables to replicated or RepNotify, create missing OnRep and server RPC function graphs, apply server/reliable flags, compile, save, and return metadata readback.

capabilities.name: ensure_blueprint_function
capabilities.label: Ensure Blueprint Function
capabilities.summary: Create or reuse a Blueprint function graph, author typed input/output pins, compile, save, and return pin readback.

capabilities.name: rename_blueprint_symbol
capabilities.label: Rename Blueprint Symbol
capabilities.summary: Rename a Blueprint member variable or function graph with structural compile/save readback.

capabilities.name: bind_niagara_user_parameters_on_begin_play
capabilities.label: Bind Niagara User Parameters On Begin Play
capabilities.summary: Create Blueprint BeginPlay setter calls that bind reflected Blueprint values to Niagara user parameters and return graph readback.

capabilities.name: list_niagara_module_inputs
capabilities.label: List Niagara Module Inputs
capabilities.summary: Read emitter stack topology and resolved module input values through UE 5.8 Niagara external edit utilities.

capabilities.name: set_niagara_user_parameter
capabilities.label: Set Niagara User Parameter
capabilities.summary: Create or replace a typed Niagara user parameter, save the system, and return readback.

capabilities.name: set_niagara_renderer_property
capabilities.label: Set Niagara Renderer Property
capabilities.summary: Mutate a renderer property through Niagara's external edit data contract and save the system.

capabilities.name: set_niagara_module_input
capabilities.label: Set Niagara Module Input
capabilities.summary: Resolve an exact emitter/script/module/input stack reference, write its typed value, and save with error readback.

capabilities.name: remove_niagara_emitter
capabilities.label: Remove Niagara Emitter
capabilities.summary: Remove a named emitter with Niagara's supported external edit utility and save the system.

capabilities.name: set_niagara_emitter_property
capabilities.label: Set Niagara Emitter Property
capabilities.summary: Mutate emitter data through Niagara's external edit data contract and save with readback.

capabilities.name: create_pose_search_schema
capabilities.label: Create Pose Search Schema
capabilities.summary: Create and save a Pose Search schema with a concrete skeleton and sample rate.

capabilities.name: add_pose_search_schema_channel
capabilities.label: Add Pose Search Schema Channel
capabilities.summary: Instantiate a typed Pose Search feature channel, apply reflected settings, save, and report channel count.

capabilities.name: create_pose_search_database
capabilities.label: Create Pose Search Database
capabilities.summary: Create and save a Pose Search database bound to a concrete schema.

capabilities.name: add_pose_search_animation
capabilities.label: Add Pose Search Animation
capabilities.summary: Add an animation asset idempotently to a Pose Search database and return count readback.

capabilities.name: remove_pose_search_animation
capabilities.label: Remove Pose Search Animation
capabilities.summary: Remove a concrete animation asset from a Pose Search database and return count readback.

capabilities.name: create_physics_asset
capabilities.label: Create Physics Asset
capabilities.summary: Generate a PhysicsAsset from a skeletal mesh, optionally assign it, save, and report body and constraint counts.

capabilities.name: add_physics_body
capabilities.label: Add Physics Body
capabilities.summary: Create a bone body with sphere, box, or capsule geometry and save it with index readback.

capabilities.name: add_physics_constraint
capabilities.label: Add Physics Constraint
capabilities.summary: Create and bind a PhysicsAsset constraint between two existing bone bodies, save, and return index readback.

capabilities.name: inspect_physics_asset
capabilities.label: Inspect Physics Asset
capabilities.summary: Read body, bone, shape, constraint, and profile topology from a PhysicsAsset.

capabilities.name: set_physics_body_property
capabilities.label: Set Physics Body Property
capabilities.summary: Set a reflected property on a named PhysicsAsset body, save it, and return typed readback.

capabilities.name: set_physics_constraint_property
capabilities.label: Set Physics Constraint Property
capabilities.summary: Set a reflected property on a named PhysicsAsset constraint template, save it, and return typed readback.

capabilities.name: set_physics_profile_property
capabilities.label: Set Physics Profile Property
capabilities.summary: Set a reflected physical-animation or constraint-profile property across matching PhysicsAsset entries, save, and report changed counts.

capabilities.name: list_physics_profiles
capabilities.label: List Physics Profiles
capabilities.summary: List named physical-animation and constraint profiles with their assignment counts.

capabilities.name: add_physics_profile
capabilities.label: Add Physics Profile
capabilities.summary: Create a physical-animation or constraint profile and optionally assign it to every compatible body or constraint.

capabilities.name: remove_physics_profile
capabilities.label: Remove Physics Profile
capabilities.summary: Remove a named physical-animation or constraint profile and all of its assignments.

capabilities.name: create_known_asset_by_class_path
capabilities.label: Create Known Asset By Class Path
capabilities.summary: Create a known Unreal asset class by reflected class path, apply typed initial properties from JSON, save, and return readback.

capabilities.name: inspect_reflected_asset
capabilities.label: Inspect Reflected Asset
capabilities.summary: Inspect reflected properties on any loaded Unreal asset and return typed exported values.

capabilities.name: set_reflected_asset_property
capabilities.label: Set Reflected Asset Property
capabilities.summary: Set a reflected asset property from JSON with type coercion, save, and read back the edited value.

capabilities.name: add_object_reference_to_reflected_array
capabilities.label: Add Object Reference To Reflected Array
capabilities.summary: Append an object reference to a reflected UObject array property, save, and report the resulting array count.

capabilities.name: remove_object_reference_from_reflected_array
capabilities.label: Remove Object Reference From Reflected Array
capabilities.summary: Remove an object reference from a reflected UObject array property, save, and report the resulting array count.

capabilities.name: author_widget_blueprint
capabilities.label: Author Widget Blueprint
capabilities.summary: Transactionally replace a Widget Blueprint design tree with a CanvasPanel and TextBlock, compile, save, and return structural readback.

capabilities.name: author_widget_blueprint_from_json
capabilities.label: Author Widget Blueprint From JSON
capabilities.summary: Transactionally author a validated Widget Blueprint hierarchy from supported panel and leaf widget specifications, compile, save, and return structural readback.

capabilities.name: author_behavior_tree_baseline
capabilities.label: Author Behavior Tree Baseline
capabilities.summary: Transactionally author Root to Selector to Wait editor topology, rebuild the runtime Behavior Tree, bind an optional Blackboard, save, and return dual readback.

capabilities.name: author_behavior_tree_wait_graph
capabilities.label: Author Behavior Tree Wait Graph
capabilities.summary: Transactionally author Root to Selector or Sequence with one or more Wait task children, rebuild runtime data, bind an optional Blackboard, save, and return dual structural readback.

capabilities.name: author_behavior_tree_task_graph
capabilities.label: Author Mixed Behavior Tree Task Graph
capabilities.summary: Transactionally author a mixed Move To and Wait task graph, resolve Blackboard keys, rebuild runtime data, save, and return editor/runtime structural readback.

capabilities.name: create_sound_cue_from_wave
capabilities.label: Create Playable Sound Cue From Wave
capabilities.python_call: unreal.AIStudioBridgeLibrary.create_sound_cue_from_wave(sound_cue_path, sound_wave_path, processor_spec_json, looping, volume_multiplier, pitch_multiplier, overwrite, save)
capabilities.summary: Create a Sound Cue with a playable Sound Wave root and optional SoundNode processor chain, configure looping, volume, and pitch, synchronize the editor graph, save, and return runtime/editor readback.
